book.name: Efesus
book.title: EFESUS Pol pepa muno bogl Efesus yomba tongwa

content: Kamambuno punga yomba nono Yesus nangiye mounga
Na, Yaglkande kongunmo ertre ana ye kane yomba moglka, ipre erme na ka giglendi di ene teinga, i ene wakai kaima moraglmedi God ene aglendi yungwa ikra mina moglpai eraglkwa.
Ana ene mogl-atne ende, yomba ka tekre, deno oglandi kumbrukre, te yomere-pamere ertre ana yomba kan wakai yenaglkwa.
Te Spirit mina yomba wu suwara pindre pokndi meglkwa i ene kongun yombuglo ere ene ake giglendi eraglkwa.
Ana nangino suwara pangwa, te Spirit suwara ta moglkwa, kuno yeglmere God ene aglendi yungwa i taragl wakai inaglkwa i keme sugl meglkwa.
Yaglkande suwara moglkwa, te pirngi suwara pangwa, te baptais suwara pangwa,
te God suwara kaima, ye yomba prapra Neno moglkwa, ye eremogl yomba mina yagl kande moglkwa, yomba prapra mina kongun orkwa te yomba prapra mina suna mogl kuno orkwa.
Ana Krais prumere yegl keunde ere God wakaimo nono prapra suwara suwarandi norkwa.
Ipre kamo i yegl dungo pangwa:

content.text: Te ye taraglmo wakai yoko yomba tongwa.”

content: Ana ye ende mitna imbo ongwa i mambunomo sraglmere pame? I mambunomo yegl, ye komnaiye kana ende atne makandle undre ende makan atne kaima ongwa.

Te yombamo ende atne ungwa suwara ikra aglke yene ende egli ongwa, kamkua merkinde i-atne endindre ana ende mitna imbo kaima ongwa, ye yegl orkwa i ana kamun mitna ya makandle taragl paingwa mo meglkwa i mina ye mogl kuno ere kondinambuka.

Ana ye yene yomba tau kongun yegl eraglkwa pre i-pene ende tongwa: Tau aposel kongun tongwa, tau propet kongun, tau kamambuno diwai dinaglkwa kongun tongwa, tau pasto kongun te tau ka beke tenaglkwa kongun,
ana ye eremogl nono God yombama akepledi kongun norkwa ana nono ye kongunmo wakai ere oun ana Krais nangiye yake kande erambuka.

Te kongunmo i nono aimande ere omun ana nono prapra pirngino mina nomane suwara yenamga. Te nono prapra God Wam Yesus wedi pirkan dime dinamga ana igle mina nono nomano suwara i kuno kuno panambuka yegl ertre ana nono yomba giglendi Krais moglkwa yeglmere nono ama yegl moramga.

Nono yeglmere plaudi mouno ana nono gak kembra mereyegl ta moglkramga. Taman. Ana kakimbi yomba undre kakimbi kanekane i-pene ende dindre nono kinano sinaglkwa i nono pirngino ta gugl sikran te mundi nigl pembigl undre taragl sikake i ongwa ya te kamun ir mange taragl sikuro i ongwa yeglmere nono ta ere sikake yembi pirngino ta gugl sikrambuka.
Ba nono yomba kanwakai yei ka kaima keunde ditenamga. Ana nono yegl ormun kade, nono yomba giglendi mogltre ana Krais mina atne kra moun ana ye nono bitno morambuka.

Ana Yesus Krais nono bitno moglkwa, ye ere endungo nono prapra onguno nangino katno, te ongumutno, perepere pangwa i suwara suwarandi kongunmo erambedi Yesus prumere erikwa. Ana nangino i ikine nono mounga, te no nono akepledi yomba ta ta tendre ana prapra wu suwara pi mounga. Nono yomba kanwakai yomga embriye i mina, ana nangino i yake wu kande pindre ana gigle dungwa.
Ken ambuglange nangiglma moramga
Ipre na erme Krais kangiye mina ka giglendi di ene teinga, ene moglpai ere enaglkwa i Yomba Bina embriyeno ya nomano kinde pango erikwa yeglmere ene erekriyo.
Ye pirpogl singwa nomano i mim ere pangwa. Te ye nomano sigegl dungo kor-moramga God tongwa igle mina ye suna moglkre ende wu eglke eingwa.

Ana angai geglkwa nomano ikra ye mina ta paikrukwa. Yeglpre taragl embriyeno kinde pamara i ye sika singwa, te ye taragl kinde erikwa i nomano mina aimande andigl pangwa, te taragl kinde nike dongwa i ningadi eramnedi pirkwa wagigldi pangwa.
Ene taragl kinde yeglmere Krais mina ta pango ene beke pirkrikwa. Tamanga.
Ene kaima Yesus Krais kamo pirtre, ana ka kaima Yesus Krais mina pangwa i yomba beke teingo ene pirkondingwa.
Ipre ene okuna mambuno goglo mina i wanmeglkwa i kinde kondinaglkwa mambuno, i ene ere kinde eragledi pre nomano mina ake nusungwa.
Yegl sika simbi ana ene nomano mina poglodi pirkwa i ukor enambuka,
ana enene nomano kor i mina wu yomba kor pindre God yene moglmere yegl mogl, yomba du-yene kaima ya holi kaima moraglkwa.
Ana yeglpre ene kakimbi dingwa embriye mambuno i kindekondo te ka kaima keunde di yomba ta magl morambuka i tenaglkwa, sraglpre, nono prapra Yesus suwara nangiye ikine mounga.
Te ene deno ta kumburan, igle mina tandaglme erekraglkwa, te deno kumbrambuka i pirwinge erimbi pai enan ana ande pi beikrambuka,
te Satan angai dumo tekraglkwa.
Yomba ta kunogl akeningandi nongwa i aglke nekre ana yene ongo mina kongunmo erambuka, ye yene mambuno kaima mina ere yagl sinendre te yomba kiuglgiunde meglkwa i akepledi tenambuka.

Katewe ya ka kinde nike dongwa i ene drano mina dikraglkwa. Ene yomba ta ka di tenaglkwa i ka wakai ya akeple dinambuka ka ditenaglkwa, yegl erimbi ana ene kanno yomba ta piran ka i akepledi tenambuka.

Ana ene eremogl taragl guagua erimbi God holi Spiritmo pir kinde ye dinambiwa, sraglpre, Holi Spirit pagl ombunodi tongo ene God yombama meglkwa, ana okuwo enge ta pandigl tongwa i plau dinan God eremogl ene topo si ikine endinambuka.
Ana ene deno munduno giu kinde orkwa ya deno kumburo karagl tongwa ya kunda noglu naglu ya te nangino ka singwa i kindekondiyo te ene ama kaglkane indre kunda ikine ere yomba ta tekraglkwa.
Ba yomba ene enene mina taragl wakai ertre, mitno gogl tendre te tandaglmeno kinde kondinaglkwa, i God eremogl Krais mina ene tandaglmeno koko endungwa yeglmere.

footnotes.text: Yomba bitno pai pogl sungwa tau ka i yeglmere i yake teingwa, “Ye komnaiye aimande ende makandle wu kondume dingwa.”
